args.notes: Major: executed TASK-179450460810 against core sha256 94936ac1... demonstrates silent invalid-date normalization. 2026-02-30T12:00:00Z becomes 2026-03-02 12:00 UTC; 2026-12-07T25:00:00Z becomes 2026-12-08 01:00 UTC. Both report flags=0. Saved evidence: products/services/tender-instant-preview/deadline-boundary-evidence.json. Reject invalid calendar/time/offset components before UTC conversion and report the deadline as indeterminable with a warning. Observations are synthetic; the saved official notices are not shown to have this defect. Existing passing parity/UI evidence does not cover these cases. Do not release this digest.

description: A targeted execution found a concrete preview defect: invalid dates silently become valid-looking UTC deadlines with no warning. This changes the next step to a bounded correction before release. Existing 33/33 parity and 15/15 UI checks remain valid within their tested scope. Feedback remains uncertain: five sources are unclassified; funding and revenue are unverified.
